subject: MedPath: Pricing breakdown for HIPAA / KMS / HSM + evidence delivery
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@medpath.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medpath.com
Date: 2028-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pricing breakdown request - HIPAA + residency options

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked the low-latency routing and prefix caching. Procurement and engineering asked me to get a clear line-item breakdown for the compliance add-ons so we can present to finance. Specifically we need:  
- Audit log retention tiers (30 / 90 / 365 days) with monthly cost impact and per-GB ingest estimate
- KMS options: pass-through managed keys vs customer-managed keys (cost delta + operational responsibilities)
- HSM (FIPS 140-2/3) seat pricing and whether it’s billed as a seat or throughput premium
- One-time implementation/attestation support fee for HIPAA evidence delivery (SOC2 extracts, key attestation)

Also: any constraints or lead-times for EU residency if we later request cross-region migration. Finally, please include what evidence and manifests you’ll need from our side so Legal can prepare.

Would you be able to send a short written summary + a preliminary quote we can attach to the vendor packet? We have a procurement cutoff Friday; a call today or tomorrow would be great.

Appreciate it — Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Engineering, MedPath
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@medpath.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-12-01T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing breakdown request - HIPAA + residency options

Samir — thanks, happy to get this over. I’m attaching a short preliminary quote (medpath_prelim_quote.pdf) and a checklist of evidence we typically deliver. High level answers below; the attached quote has the exact line items. Quick summary: 

- Audit logs: three retention tiers. 30-day: included at baseline (up to 200GB/mo). 90-day: +$0.015/GB/mo for storage; 365-day: +$0.035/GB/mo. Ingest is charged at $0.005/GB. We provide a daily export snapshot for longer retention upon request.

- KMS: two pathways. Redwood-managed KMS (no incremental cost beyond a small key usage fee included in the quote) vs Customer-managed (bring-your-own KMS/HSM via customer key material). Customer-managed has an ongoing per-key usage surcharge (~$750/mo per CMK proxy) and requires MFA provisioning windows for rotations. We note that for very high key counts we recommend a small onboarding automation charge (one-time).

- HSM: certified FIPS HSM is sold as a mix of seat + throughput premium. Our standard seat: $3,500/month per HSM seat (includes 24/7 attestation logs). Throughput premium: +12% on token-processing price when HSM-bound model variants are used. For pilots we can offer a temporary reduced seat rate for first 3 months; the quote includes a pilot concession.

- Implementation/evidence support: we offer an Implementation/Attestation package (one-time) that covers SOC2 artifact export, attestation coordination, and on-prem evidence packaging. The package is $18,000 for standard scope; extended scope (on-site/air-gapped evidence handling) is additional. Time to delivery for standard scope: ~3 weeks after PO and evidence checklist items are received.

- EU residency: cross-region migration is supported but lead-times vary (typically 4-6 weeks for reserved capacity + data transfer approvals). Regional routing policies can be put in place earlier for test traffic.

Attached: medpath_prelim_quote.pdf and a short evidence checklist; Ben has also included an evidence manifest to show what we pull from the system. If you’d like, we can do a 30-minute call at 11:30 PT today to walk the line items.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
Attachment: medpath_prelim_quote.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@medpath.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-12-01T11:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing breakdown request - HIPAA + residency options

Adding a couple of technical clarifications that affect pricing and what you should include in the PO: 

1) HSM seat vs throughput: if you expect >1M tokens/day on HSM-bound models we recommend the blended-throughput path. For small pilots (<200k tokens/day) it’s cheaper to buy a single HSM seat with the temporary pilot discount in Irene’s quote. The seat covers the attestation stream and hardware SLA.

2) Audit log sizing: our internal estimate uses a 1.2x multiplier for JSON-wrapped audit events. If you project 100k requests/day with an average 3KB event, that’s ~360GB/month before compression. The 90/365 tiers above assume compressed storage. We included an example worksheet (evidence_manifest.xlsx) to help map your traffic.

3) Evidence delivery: we can deliver SOC2 extracts as encrypted S3 bundles. For egress-sensitive customers we provide a signed manifest + hashed archive that Legal can verify. For on-prem evidence handling (air-gapped) we require a scoped SOW and additional lead time.

I attached the evidence_manifest.xlsx with the columns procurement usually asks for (artifact, retention, typical size, export method). Happy to walk through the worksheet on the call.

—Ben
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
